body:
CANONICAL: authority and landing rules for Engram (Engram::Fable, 2026-10-03; rev 2 on 2026-10-25 updates the stand-in rule and the carry rule to the checked-in text at d800d17f). The CONTROLLING TEXT is AGENTS.md and the identical CLAUDE.md, sections Authority and Git, Required Quality Gates and Review Cadence, plus .claude/commands/review-changes.md. Read the current text when acting. This note records Greg's words and the agreed readings, and carries no higher authority than his current word.

STANDING APPROVAL (Greg, 2026-09-26 in session-7284: "if all criteria are met I approve commit, that is the rule. There is no point of waiting for me."; 2026-09-27 in Advisor session-6219: "regula jest taka sama dla Engram i Termal / jezeli review nie ma uwag i testy sa green, / taski maja evidence ze mozna je zamknac / to robimy commit"). Commit, push and install without asking once ALL hold:
(1) The applicable checks pass on the exact final tree, with the fingerprint checked at completion and no edit since. A changeset of only .md files runs the link check and the AGENTS/CLAUDE identity check through the focused launcher; any other path runs the full gate.
(2) The latest round from two independent read-only reviewers of different vendors, Codex and Claude, has no outstanding in-scope finding of Medium or higher, and every earlier in-scope Medium or higher was fixed and reviewed again. Since d800d17f, a clean round the Coder completed before READY also counts after the Merger's clean carry onto a moved master under `/review-changes` section 6a; see that text for the carry proof. Notes and Lows don't block (Greg, 2026-09-30: "ignore Notes and trivial lows, that can be handled later. if they choose to fix low, fine, but that is not must have / anything including Medium must be fixed"); a Low left unfixed is filed as its own item. While Codex or Claude is unavailable (a usage limit or outage, with the refusal text recorded on the item), Kimi stands in for the unavailable reviewer, never for both reviewers of one round. An unavailable review is not a clean review. A pre-existing problem outside the changed scope, filed as an independent root with provenance, doesn't block. An in-scope finding of Medium or higher left unfixed, even one rejected on evidence, goes to Greg.
(3) The changeset delivers its acceptance criteria, including host-observed evidence where a criterion binds it. A criterion saying "decided with Greg" needs his recorded word. (Acceptance evaluations are currently deferred by Greg; see rules-greg-checkin-tests-review-stop-evaluations-2026-10-24.)
(4) The changeset was judged first (durable-row and projection changes, see rules-install-and-cutover), and readiness with the new build reported every live store ready.
Otherwise stop and ask Greg: a store needs repair or migration, a criterion can't be met or is disputed, the scope goes beyond the items, a rebase, force-push or history rewrite is needed, or a required review is unavailable without a permitted stand-in. Outside the standing approval, a commit or push needs Greg's own word in the acting session; a relayed word never carries a commit or push. Report the landed commit to Greg afterwards.

COMMIT MEANS PUSH AND INSTALL (Greg, 2026-09-23: "push and install, make a rule commit means push and install"; 2026-09-28: "Fable ma racje to dobra regula. W sumie mamy system kontroli. Agenci moga podejnowac takie decyzje."). Greg's word "commit" for a presented changeset also authorizes pushing it and installing its build. One approval covers one presented changeset. Rebase, force-push and history rewrites always need their own explicit word. A landing installs the binary built from the exact landed commit and records the full build_fingerprint from readiness.

AUTHORITY-TEXT RULE. Changes to Authority and Git, or to any instruction or command file that grants or limits commit, push, tracker or approval authority, land only after: (a) both coordinators' recorded concurrence on the exact wording; (b) the exact wording and its consequence sent to Greg before landing (his objection by any route stops it); (c) the final-diff audit /review-changes requires, recorded on the item, including the compiled freeze checks before and after and the passage script. A widening also needs Greg's recorded word, verbatim with its source; recording his words, narrowing or clarifying needs only (a), (b) and (c). Where a coordinator worded the change, the OTHER project's coordinator does the audit. Scope (both coordinators, 2026-09-30, ebe242f7 #220-222): in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md the covered text is that section plus any other passage that grants or limits such authority; every other instruction or command file that does so is covered WHOLE (for example .claude/commands/review-changes.md, docs/agent-pair-workflow.md and .agents/skills/team-coordination/SKILL.md); the coordinator rules a change outside and records why; in doubt it is covered.
